blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present onPanda, an interactive tool for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories. onPanda adopts token-level correction as its core interaction: while reading a model response, the annotator locates the first inappropriate token and either picks a substitute from the model’s candidate tokens or types the correct text via free-form editing. The system then truncates everything after that position and continues generation from the corrected prefix, repeating this locate-correct-continue loop until a satisfactory response is obtained. This mechanism lets annotators precisely steer model outputs at low cost: a small controlled study suggests that onPanda reduces median annotation time by 52% over manual post-editing. Since the vast majority of tokens in the final response are generated by the model itself, the resulting data largely preserves the model’s sampling distribution and is well suited for constructing on-policy SFT and preference data. Furthermore, the token-level corrections recorded during annotation provide fine-grained supervision with precise positions and naturally paired positive–negative samples. onPanda also connects to external tools and harnesses, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. In addition, we release Panda-CVL, a dataset annotated with onPanda, together with a benchmark for token-level correction.
blocks.zh: 我们在熊猫上展示一个互动工具,用于高效地注释LLM对齐数据和代理轨迹. 在Panda上采用符号级校正作为其核心交互:在读取模型响应时,注释者会定位第一个不适当的符号,或者从模型候选的符号中选择一个替代物,或者通过自由格式的编辑键入正确的文本. 系统然后切除该位置后的一切,然后从修正的前缀继续生成,重复这个定位-正确-连续循环,直到得到令人满意的响应. 这种机制让注释者以低成本精确地引导模型输出:一个小的控制研究表明,熊猫在手动编辑后将中位注释时间减少52%. 由于最后反应中的绝大多数信物是由模型本身产生的,因此所产生的数据在很大程度上保留了模型的抽样分布,并且非常适合构建政策方面的SFT和偏好数据. 此外,在注解中记录的象征性的校正提供了精确位置和自然配对的正负性样本的精细监督。 熊猫号上还连接到外部工具和利用,使得在现实环境中可以进行交互的轨迹注释. 此外,我们还发布了Panda-CVL,一个带有Panda上注释的数据集,以及一个符号级修正的基准.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scaling high-quality data remains the central bottleneck for LLM alignment and agents. Existing pipelines struggle to reconcile annotation cost, on-policy fidelity, and supervision granularity: manually writing Ouyang et al. (2022) ; Nakano et al. (2022) or post-editing Yao et al. (2023) ; Scheurer et al. (2024) ; Schick et al. (2023) responses for SFT Ranzato et al. (2016) ; Arora et al. (2022) is costly and yields off-policy data, while preference data is cheaper but offers only coarse response-level supervision Lightman et al. (2024) ; Uesato et al. (2022) ; Wu et al. (2023) and, being confined to candidates the model can already sample, provides little corrective signal when the model cannot sample good responses. Annotating agent trajectories is even harder: a trajectory arises from multi-step environment interaction, so any correction must actually execute tools and obtain real feedback before generation continues. Existing tools Jurgens et al. (2026) ; Ou et al. (2025) can observe and score live agents and intervene mid-run, and Reptile Dou et al. (2025) further lets annotators edit model-output text that its terminal environment then executes; yet the community still lacks an interactive tool that, across diverse environments, both corrects general reasoning and tool calls in real time and executes the corrected calls. We therefore develop onPanda ( on - P olicy a lig n ment d ata a nnotator), an interactive tool for efficiently annotating alignment data and agent trajectories.
blocks.zh: 扩大高质量数据仍然是LLM调整和代理的主要瓶颈。 现有管道在调和注释成本、政策诚信和监督颗粒性方面挣扎不已:手工写作Ouyang等人(2022年);Nakano等人(2022年)或编辑后姚等人(2023年);Scheurer等人(2024年);Schick等人(2023年)对SFT Ranzato等人的答复(2016年);Arora等人(2022年)费用昂贵,得出了政策外的数据,而偏好数据更便宜,但只提供粗细的反应层监督Lightman等人(2024年);Uesato等人(2022年);Wu等人(2023年),以及当模型无法对良好反应进行抽样时,其提供的纠正信号很少。 注释代理轨迹更难:一个轨迹产生于多步环境相互作用,因此任何修正都必须实际执行工具,并在生成前获得真正的反馈. 现有的工具Jurgens等人(2026年);Ou等人(2025年)可以观察和评分活性剂并干预中跑,以及Reptile Dou等人. (2025)进一步让注释者编辑其终端环境随后执行的模型输出文本;然而社区仍然缺乏一个交互工具,通过不同环境,既能实时纠正一般推理,又能执行被更正的呼叫. 因此,我们开发了Panda(P policy a lig n ment d ata a notator),这是一个高效地注释对齐数据和代理轨迹的交互式工具。

blocks.en: onPanda’s token-level correction interaction lets annotators precisely control and steer LLM generation, as illustrated in Figure 1 . While reading a model response, the annotator only needs to locate the first inappropriate token; onPanda displays the model’s top- k k candidate tokens with their probabilities at that position: the annotator simply clicks a suitable substitute if one exists, or double-clicks the token and types arbitrary replacement text when the candidates miss the correct direction. After each correction, the system truncates the subsequent content and lets the model continue from the updated prefix—hence the annotator no longer needs to re-read the entire response after a fix, but simply repeats this “locate–correct–continue” loop along the response until it meets the requirements.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,在熊猫的符号级校正互动上,可以让注释者精确控制并引导LLM生成。 在读取模型响应时,注释员只需要找到第一个不恰当的符号;在熊猫上显示模型的顶级-k候选符号,并显示其在该位置上的概率:如果有的话,注释员只是点击一个合适的替代物,或者在候选物错过正确方向时双击该符号和任意的替换文字. 每次更正后,系统会缩短后续内容,让模型从更新的前缀继续使用——因此,注释员不再需要在固定后重新读取整个响应,而只是将这个"位置 - 正确 - 继续"的循环沿响应重复到满足要求为止.

blocks.en: This paradigm directly addresses the above bottlenecks, bringing four advantages: (1) Efficient annotation. Most corrections are mouse clicks, with brief typing only when the candidates fall short—a far lower cognitive and typing burden than writing from scratch or manual post-editing; the linear “correct-as-you-read” workflow also avoids repeated review of the entire response, further cutting time cost. (2) High on-policy fidelity. Human intervention touches only the few erroneous positions; the vast majority of tokens are generated by the rollout model itself, either sampled directly from the prompt or continued from a corrected prefix, and corrections drawn from the model’s own high-probability candidates perturb the sampling distribution even less. Unlike manual post-editing, the resulting SFT data thus stays close to the rollout model’s distribution. (3) Fine-grained supervision. Alongside the SFT data, onPanda automatically records every token-level correction, capturing the error position, the substitute token, and a naturally paired positive–negative sample. These signals are finer-grained than response-level preferences: they can be converted into preference data for reward model or DPO training, or into process reward data for PRM training, based on the step containing the corrected token and its preceding steps. (4) Complete expressiveness. Free-form editing is a fallback beyond candidate selection, freeing annotation from the limits of the top- k k candidate set: even when the model cannot sample the correct content on its own—where preference annotation can hardly help—the annotator can still inject the correct text and steer subsequent generation. Such injections deviate from the model’s own distribution, but occur only at the few positions beyond its capability, trading a minimal distributional cost for correctness. Hence, whenever the annotator can recognize and supply the correct fix, onPanda can construct SFT samples that meet the task requirements.
blocks.zh: 这一模式直接解决了上述瓶颈问题,带来四个优点: (1) 有效的注释。 多数更正是鼠标点击,只有在候选人不足时才进行简短的打字——这是远远低于从头到尾或手动编辑后写作的认知和打字负担;线性 " 正确现读 " 工作流程也避免了对整个答复的重复审查,进一步削减了时间成本。 (2) 高度政策忠诚。 人类干预只触及少数错误位置;绝大多数信物是由推出模型本身产生的,要么直接从即时样本中抽取,要么从修正的前缀中继续抽取,而从模型本身的高概率候选人身上提取的校正则对抽样分布产生更大的干扰。 与手动编辑后的数据不同,由此产生的SFT数据因此与推出模型的分布保持了接近. (3)精细监管. 除了SFT数据之外,熊猫上还自动记录每个符号级的校正,捕捉错误位置,替代符号,以及一个自然成对的正负样本. 这些信号比响应级偏好更精细:可以根据包含修正的符号的步骤和之前的步骤,将其转换成奖励模式或DPO训练的优惠数据,或PRM训练的流程奖励数据. (4) 完全表达。 Free-form编辑是超出候选选择的倒计时,将注释从顶级-k候选集的极限中解脱出来:即使模型无法自行对正确的内容进行抽样——其中偏好注释几乎无济于事——注释者仍然可以注入正确的文本并引导后一代. 这种注射方式偏离了模型本身的分布方式,但只在其能力之外的少数位置进行,为了正确性而以最低的分布成本进行交易。 因此,每当注释者能够识别和提供正确的固定装置时,熊猫号上就可以建造符合任务要求的SFT样本.

blocks.en: For agent settings, onPanda can access tools via MCP and connect to harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. Its intuitive interface further suits model inspection.
blocks.zh: 对于代理设置,在熊猫上可以通过MCP访问工具,并连接到克劳德代码,Codex,和OpenClaw等工具,使得在现实环境中可以交互的轨迹注释. 它的直观界面进一步进行了套装模型检查.

blocks.en: In addition, we release Panda-CVL (a C hinese V ision– L anguage dataset for token-level correction), annotated with onPanda, together with an accompanying benchmark, to facilitate community research on this new type of data.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们发布了Panda-CVL(一种C hinese V ision – Language data set,用于表示值级校正),附加了Panda上的注释,并附有一个配套基准,以促进社区对这一新型数据的研究.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We propose onPanda, an annotation tool centered on token-level correction for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories that stay close to the rollout model’s distribution. • We experimentally validate onPanda’s annotation efficiency and the on-policy fidelity of the produced data, and demonstrate its support for multimodal and agent-trajectory annotation. • We release the multimodal Panda-CVL dataset with an accompanying benchmark, providing public resources for research on token-level correction data.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们提议在熊猫上建立一个以符号级校正为核心的注释工具,以高效地标注LLM校正数据和与推出模型分布相近的代理轨迹。 我们试验验证熊猫的注解效率和所生成数据的政策可靠性,并表明它支持多式联运和代理人-弹射式注解。 我们发布了附有基准的多模式熊猫-CVL数据集,为象征性校正数据的研究提供公共资源。

blocks.en: 2 Design and Implementation
blocks.zh: 2 设计和实施

blocks.en: 2.1 System Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 系统概览

blocks.en: onPanda is a componentized front-end library with two usage modes. As a lightweight web app, it works out of the box: deployed via static hosting without any database, it lets users drag in local annotation files and start annotating, with the browser sending requests to preset or custom Chat Completions APIs. Alternatively, its components can be embedded into an existing data platform whose backend handles task dispatching and data collection—the form in which onPanda is integrated into our in-house production annotation system. onPanda only requires the inference API to (i) continue generation from an assistant-message prefix (e.g., vLLM’s continue_final_message ) and (ii) return each token’s top- k k candidates with probabilities (logprobs). All artifacts of an annotation session—messages, annotations, operation logs, and probability caches—are serialized into a single .panda.json file for easy distribution, collection, and parsing.
blocks.zh: OnPanda是一个组件化的前端库,有两个使用模式. 作为轻量级的网络应用程序,它的工作原理出乎框外:通过静态主机部署,没有任何数据库,它让用户在本地注释文件中拖动并开始注释,由浏览器发送请求以预设或自定义ChatProfessions API. 或者,其组成部分可以嵌入一个现有数据平台,其后端处理任务发送和数据收集工作——即将熊猫号纳入我们内部生产注释系统的形式。 OnPanda只要求推断 API 到 (一) 从一个助理消息前缀继续生成(例如 vLLM 的 continual_final_message) 和 (二) 返回每个符号的顶级- k k 候选人的概率(log probs) 。 注释会话的所有文物——信息、说明、操作日志和概率缓存——被序列化为单一的.panda.json文件,以便于分发、收集并解析。

blocks.en: 2.2 Token-Level Correction Engine
blocks.zh: 2.2 托肯级校正引擎

blocks.en: Generation requests stream with logprobs: onPanda records each token’s sampled probability and top- k k (default 20) candidates, and renders the corresponding probability color below each token (Figure 1 a). Since tokenizers may split a multi-byte character or emoji across tokens, the UI groups the token stream into minimal readable units ( chunks ) along grapheme boundaries: interaction operates on chunks, while records stay token-precise. Each correction preserves three pieces of information: the correction position, the text replacement, and the samples before and after the correction.
blocks.zh: 生成请求流带有logprobs:在熊猫上记录每个令牌的样本概率和顶级-k(默认为20)候选人,并让每个令牌下方的相应概率颜色(图1a). 由于指示器可能将一个多字节字符或emoji拆分到符号之间,UI将符号流按照石墨边界分组成最小的可读单位(块):交互运行在块上,而记录则保持符号精度. 每一次校正保存三条信息:校正位置,文本替换,以及校正前后的样本.

blocks.en: After the annotator clicks a candidate or double-clicks to edit, onPanda truncates everything after the correction point and requests native continuation with the corrected response as the assistant prefix; tokens before the correction point are kept as-is rather than regenerated. Text introduced by free-form editing initially has no probability information; a single prompt_logprobs request recomputes per-token probabilities and candidates for the entire response (this feature additionally requires prompt_logprobs support from the API). This “refresh” also applies to arbitrary external text and cross-model settings: pasting any response into onPanda (or switching the model) reveals the current model’s confidence on every token, making onPanda double as a model-inspection tool.
blocks.zh: 在注释器点击一个候选人或双击进行编辑后,在Panda上将校正点后的所有内容都截断,并请求以校正的回复作为助手前缀进行本土续作;校正点前的符号保存为-即位而非再生成. 由自由格式编辑引入的文本最初没有概率信息;单一的 proogle_logprobs 请求重算 per-token 概率和整个响应的候选人(此特性还需要 API 的 proogrobs 支持). 这种"更新"也适用于任意的外部文本和跨模型设置:将任何响应粘贴到熊猫上(或切换模型),揭示了当前模型对每个标志的信心,使熊猫上双倍成为模型检查工具.

blocks.en: 2.3 Annotation Tree and Data Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.3 注释树和数据协议

blocks.en: An annotation session is organized as an annotation tree whose nodes are dialogs, each containing a complete copy of the messages and tools together with their annotations. Each correction forks a new node whose parent is the pre-correction dialog (Dialogs [1,2,3] in Figure 1 form a three-node chain: the initial rollout and two iterative corrections). All intermediate versions are thus saved automatically, without any version management by the annotator. Each node carries an operation log recording the operation type, timestamp, correction content, whether the operation is marked as on-policy, and a snapshot of the sampling configuration, giving every data point fully traceable provenance.
blocks.zh: 组织一个注释会话,作为注释树,其节点为对话框,每个节点包含完整的信件和工具副本及其说明. 每个修正叉新节点,其母为前修正对话框(图1中的Dialogs [1,2,3]组成一个三节点链:初始推出和两个迭代更正). 所有中间版本都因此自动保存,没有注释器的任何版本管理. 每个节点都带有一个操作日志,记录操作类型,时间戳,校正内容,是否将操作标记为政策上,以及抽样配置的快照,让每个数据点完全可追踪的来源.

blocks.en: Each dialog also carries a quality verdict is_good and a project-defined annotation schema (single-choice, multiple-choice, text, etc.). The companion Python library onpanda parses .panda.json into training data: nodes with is_good=Y are exported as SFT samples, and positive–negative nodes under the same prompt are paired into response-level preference data. Within such pairs, the negative is typically an ancestor of the positive: the two share the prefix before the correction point and diverge exactly there, so the corresponding token-level correction data can be computed under any tokenizer as triples (negative sample, rejected token and its position, chosen token). Such data provides supervision that is precise in both position and update direction; positive and negative tokens pair one-to-one at the same position, so optimization receives naturally balanced signals. We believe these properties make token-level correction a promising cornerstone for more efficient post-training methods.
blocks.zh: 每个对话框还包含一个质量判断是_好和工程定义的注释计划(单选,多选,文本等). 同伴Python库 onpanda pares .panda.json 进入训练数据:节点为_good= Y作为 SFT 样本导出,在相同的提示下正负节点被对成响应级偏好数据. 在这样的对子中,负数一般是正数的祖先:两个在校正点之前共享前缀,并在那里完全偏差,因此相应的符号级校正数据可以在任何代号符下计算为三重(负样,拒绝的代号及其位置,选择的代号). 此类数据提供在位置和更新方向上均精确的监管;正对和负对的符号在同一位置对一对一,因此优化会得到自然平衡的信号. 我们认为,这些特性使象征性的校正成为提高培训后方法效率的有希望的基石。

blocks.en: 2.4 Agentic and Multimodal Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.4 代理和多式联运说明

blocks.en: Responses of reasoning models and agents are not plain text but structured messages containing reasoning , content , and tool_calls , which resist direct token-level correction and continuation. onPanda addresses this with the response template mechanism, which converts bidirectionally between structured messages and the model’s native token stream: the rendering direction produces, per the model’s response template, the full token sequence with special tokens (e.g., </think> , <|tool_call_begin|> ) for display, correction, and continuation; the parsing direction restores the generated stream into structured messages in real time for storage and tool execution. Special tokens are directly visible and correctable by annotators, so token-level correction uniformly covers reasoning chains, content, and tool-call arguments (Figure 2 ). Since dialogs are stored in structured form and a model’s response template is applied only during rendering and correction, the same data can be further corrected and continued by different models.
blocks.zh: 推理模型和代理的反应不是纯文本,而是包含推理,内容,和工具_calls 的结构化信息,它们抵制直接符号级的校正和延续. OnPanda用响应模板机制处理,它将结构化的信息和模型的本地信号流双向转换: 渲染方向按照模型的响应模板,生成带有特殊信号的完整信号序列(如 </think > , QQtool_call_begin_|>),用于显示,校正和继续; 解析方向将生成的信息流实时恢复为结构化的信息,用于存储和工具执行. 特殊符号由注释者直接可见和可更正,所以符号级的校正统一覆盖了推理链,内容,以及工具调用参数(图2 ). 由于对话框以结构化的形式存储,且模型的响应模板只在渲染和校正时才应用,所以同一数据可以被不同的模型进一步校正和延续.

blocks.en: External environments and tools connect via MCP; the harness_to_mcp adapter wraps existing harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw into MCP servers for onPanda. Tool calls can be configured to await annotator approval before execution: a problematic call can be executed after its arguments are corrected, or rejected with optional textual guidance, and rejected trajectories are automatically kept as negative samples. Tool results are fed back into the context and generation continues, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. onPanda likewise supports inputting, displaying, and annotating image, audio, and video messages.
blocks.zh: 外部环境和工具通过 MCP 连接; cape_to_mcp 适配器将克劳德代码, Codex 和 OpenClaw 等已有的hape 包裹到 MCP 服务器中,用于熊猫上. 工具调用可以配置以等待注释者批准执行前:一个有问题的调用可以在它的论证得到纠正后执行,或者用可选的文字指导拒绝,被拒绝的轨迹自动保存为负样本. 工具结果反馈到上下文中,生成过程还在继续,从而能够在现实环境中进行互动的轨迹说明。 在Panda上同样支持输入、显示和注释图像、音频和视频信息。

blocks.en: 3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 评价

blocks.en: 3.1 Annotation Efficiency and Data Quality
blocks.zh: 3.1 说明效率和数据质量

blocks.en: We compare against two mainstream annotation paradigms: (1) manual post-editing : the answer box is pre-filled with the model’s initial rollout, which the annotator edits until it meets the SFT quality bar; (2) preference ranking : four rollouts are pre-generated per prompt; the annotator ranks them and records whether the best one qualifies as SFT data. The two paradigms are instantiated with the widely used POTATO and Argilla, both full-featured, freely configurable platforms that we set up as the most typical alignment-data workflows. Because each platform differs in both its interface and annotation paradigm, this comparison evaluates complete workflows, making it difficult to determine whether the observed gains arise from the interface, the paradigm, or their combination.
blocks.zh: 我们比较两个主流的注释范式:(1) 手动编辑后: 答案框与模型的初始推出预填, 由注释者编辑, 直至它符合 SFT 质量栏; (2) 优先排序 : 4 个推出预排每个即时生成; 注释者将其排序并记录最佳的版本是否符合 SFT 数据 。 这两个范式与广泛使用的POTATO和Argilla即时反应,两者都是全功能的,可自由配置的平台,我们建立了这些平台作为最典型的对齐数据工作流程. 由于每个平台在界面和注释范式上都不同,因此这一比较评价了完整的工作流程,使得难以确定观察到的收益是来自界面,范式,还是两者的组合.

blocks.en: Three annotators labeled 21 image-description prompts, evenly split into 3 groups. A Latin-square design rotates the order of the three methods: each group is annotated exactly once per method and no annotator labels the same prompt with different methods, balancing prompt difficulty, individual proficiency, and ordering effects. None of the annotators are onPanda developers, and all completed training and warm-up tasks on all three methods. Initial rollouts are generated by the same model, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (instruct mode), with the officially recommended sampling parameters (temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.8); onPanda, POTATO, and Argilla’s first candidate share the same rollout to reduce sampling randomness.
blocks.zh: 三个注释者标注了21个图像描述提示,均匀分为3组. 拉丁方块设计会旋转三种方法的顺序:每组方法都精确附加注释一次,没有注释者用不同方法给相同的提示标记,平衡迅速难度,个人熟练程度,以及命令效果. 注释员中没有一个是熊猫开发者,所有完成了三种方法的培训和热身任务. 初始推出由同一型号生成,Qwen3.5-35B-A3B(指令模式),具有官方推荐的采样参数(温度0.7,顶端-p 0.8);在熊猫,POTATO上,Argilla的第一个候选人共享相同的推出,以减少采样随机性.

blocks.en: We report five metrics. (1) Time : median annotation time, with the mean also reported; the median is robust to the long tail of difficult prompts, while the mean reflects total human cost. (2) Pairwise win rate : for each prompt, the three outputs—the final responses from onPanda and POTATO and Argilla’s top-ranked response—are compared pairwise by GPT-5.5, with each pair evaluated in both orders to reduce position bias. (3) PPL : response perplexity under the rollout model, used to measure on-policy fidelity. We independently sample four rollouts per prompt, use their mean PPL as the baseline, and report both each method’s PPL and its relative change ( Δ \Delta PPL). (4) SFT coverage : the proportion of prompts that yield a qualified SFT response; under preference ranking, all four rollouts may be unqualified. (5) Preference pairs : the average number of preference pairs obtained per prompt.
blocks.zh: 我们报告五个标准。 (1)时间:中值注解时间,平均值也报告;中值坚固到困难提示的长尾,平均值反映人的总成本. (2) 对等胜率:对于每个速率,用GPT-5.5对三种结果进行对偶比较,对三种结果——来自熊猫岛和POTATO以及Argilla排位最高的反应——进行评价,以减少位置偏差。 (3) PPL:推出模式下的反应复杂度,用于衡量政策忠诚度。 我们独立地抽取了每批4个推广点, 使用它们的平均PPL作为基线, (4) SFT的覆盖范围:产生合格SFT响应的提示比例;在优先排序下,所有四个推出都可能是不合格的. (5)首选配对 :每个即时获得的首选配对的平均数量.

blocks.en: As Table 1 shows, onPanda’s median time is 330 s per prompt, 51.5% less than POTATO’s 681 s and on par with Argilla’s 336 s; in means, onPanda (515.6 s) is 27.5% and 24.7% lower than POTATO (711.1 s) and Argilla (684.5 s). Argilla’s mean far exceeds its median, consistent with the long right tail of reviewing four lengthy responses on hard prompts. Part of the gain over POTATO stems from continuation: a hallucination or error often recurs across a response—post-editing must spot and fix every occurrence, whereas onPanda corrects only its first occurrence and the continuation stays consistent with the fix. onPanda also attains the highest pairwise win rate (66.7%), suggesting that the efficiency gain does not come at the cost of quality; an anonymized human comparison further supports this result: human evaluators preferred onPanda over POTATO in 54.8% of pairs.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,熊猫的中位时间为每秒330秒,比POTATO的681秒少51.5%,与Argilla的336秒相同;从数量上看,熊猫的(515.6秒)比POTATO(711.1秒)和Argilla(684.5秒)少27.5%和24.7%。 Argilla的平均值远远超过它的中位数, 与POTATO相比,部分收益来自持续性:幻觉或误差经常在反应中反复出现——编辑后必须发现并固定每起事件,而熊猫号上只更正了第一次发生,并且持续性与固定不变。 在熊猫上还取得了最高的双向胜率(66.7%),这表明效率增益不会以质量为代价;一个匿名的人类比较进一步支持了这一结果:人类评价者倾向于在熊猫上比POTATO在54.8%的对上.

blocks.en: On on-policy fidelity, onPanda and Argilla reach PPL 1.181 ( Δ \Delta PPL + 0.86 % +0.86\% ) and 1.161 ( − 0.83 % -0.83\% ), both within 1% of the baseline (1.171) and within re-sampling noise (per-prompt PPL fluctuates by about ± 2.8 % \pm 2.8\% across rollouts); POTATO yields 1.596 ( + 36.31 % +36.31\% ). onPanda thus preserves the rollout model’s sampling characteristics much better than manual post-editing. Meanwhile, Argilla selects a qualified SFT response on only 11/21 (52%) prompts, whereas the editing-based POTATO and onPanda keep editing until the response qualifies, reaching 100% coverage by design. onPanda further derives 7.43 preference pairs per prompt, precisely aligned to correction positions, versus 6 from Argilla’s four-way ranking and 0.95 from POTATO’s pre-/post-edit pair (one initial rollout qualified without edits).

blocks.en: 3.2 User Study and Real-World Deployment
blocks.zh: 3.2 用户研究和实际世界部署

blocks.en: The three annotators then filled out an adapted NASA-TLX questionnaire following Nakano et al. (2022) for each tool, rating workload on 6 subscales from 0 to 10. We averaged the six ratings per annotator and then across annotators, with lower scores indicating lower workload. onPanda achieved the lowest score (3.1), compared with Argilla (5.4) and POTATO (6.8). One annotator remarked: “onPanda gives immediate feedback—I can see my progress on each item; the ranking workflow instead forced me to hold a very long context in mind, which was mentally taxing.” Another noted: “The probability shading speeds up locating what to fix—low-probability tokens often mean the model is less confident and more error-prone, so checking them first makes annotation faster.”
blocks.zh: 三位注释员随后填写了Nakano等人(2022年)之后对每个工具的经过调整的NASA-TLX调查表,将6个分尺度的工作量评为0至10级。 我们平均评分为每名注释员6分,然后跨注释员,分数较低表明工作量较低。 与Argilla(5.4)和POTATO(6.8)相比,熊猫号取得了最低分数(3.1). 一位注释员说:“熊猫上立即提供反馈——我可以看到我在每个项目上的进展;排名工作流程迫使我想起一个很长的背景,这是精神上的课税。” 另一位与会者指出, " 概率的阴影加速了确定要修理什么——低概率符号往往意味着模型不那么自信,而且更容易出错,因此首先检查它们会更快地作出注释。 “

blocks.en: Since deployment, onPanda has continuously produced three types of production data—vision, audio, and agentic—with 25,596, 105,143, and 1,257 annotation sessions respectively, automatically yielding about 388K token-level corrections (see Table 2 in appendix). Across all qualified responses, 97.0% of tokens are model-generated, 2.1% are selected from candidates, and only 0.9% are manually typed, showing sparse human intervention at production scale.
blocks.zh: 自部署以来,熊猫上不断制作三种类型的制作数据——视觉、音频和代理数据,分别为25,596、105,143和1,257次注释会,自动产生约388K个符号级的更正(见附录表2)。 在所有合格的回复中,97.0%的代币是模型生成的,2.1%的代币是从候选人中挑选出来的,只有0.9%的代币是手动打字的,显示人类在生产规模上的干预很少.

blocks.en: 3.3 Model Inspection
blocks.zh: 3.3 示范检查

blocks.en: onPanda supports model diagnosis through token-probability visualization. Given a selected model and arbitrary text, it displays per-token generation probabilities using color coding and entropy statistics. This helps users diagnose whether a faulty rollout originates from the model or from a pipeline error, inspect error probabilities and candidate distributions at critical positions, and combine probability analysis with token-level correction to steer generation along alternative paths. Together, these features provide fine-grained feedback for model behavior analysis and data quality auditing.
blocks.zh: 在熊猫上通过符号概率可视化支持模型诊断. 考虑到一个选定的模型和任意文本,它会使用彩色编码和 en统计来显示每个托肯生成概率. 这有助于用户判断一个错误的推出是源于模型还是源于管道错误,检查关键位置的误差概率和候选分布,并将概率分析与符号级校正相结合,引导生成沿着替代路径进行. 这些特征共同为模型行为分析和数据质量审计提供了精细的反馈.

blocks.en: 4 Dataset and Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4 数据集和基准

blocks.en: To support research on token-level correction data and its downstream applications, we construct Panda-CVL , a publicly releasable subset of production data annotated using onPanda. We apply two filtering criteria: (1) all images are either created in-house or obtained from openly licensed sources (see the Ethics section); and (2) the tasks do not require internal business knowledge and instead evaluate general-purpose capabilities such as visual perception, image description, and visual reasoning. Panda-CVL is a predominantly Chinese vision-language dataset comprising 7,491 annotation sessions stored in the .panda.json format, with 6,839 sessions in the training set and 652 in the test set. The auxiliary rollouts used during annotation were generated using step-1o-turbo , a 32B-parameter dense VLM.
blocks.zh: 为了支持对象征级校正数据及其下游应用的研究,我们构建了熊猫-CVL(Panda-CVL),这是使用Panda上注释的可公开发布的生产数据子集. 我们采用两个过滤标准:(1)所有图像要么是内部生成的,要么是从公开许可的来源获得的(见道德部分);(2)任务不需要内部商业知识,而是评价视觉感知,图像描述,视觉推理等通用能力. 熊猫-CVL是一个以中文为主的视觉语言数据集,包含储存在.panda.json格式的7,491个注释会,培训会场6,839个,测试会场652个. 注释中使用的辅助推展使用阶-1-涡轮式,即32B参数的密集VLM.

blocks.en: A single token-level correction performed by an annotator can be decomposed into three subtasks: (1) determine whether the response meets the quality standard for acceptable SFT data, in which case the annotator marks is_good=Y and submits it; otherwise, (2) identify the first inappropriate token in the response; and (3) correct it to an appropriate token, either by selecting from candidate tokens or by manually editing it. Following this decomposition, we evaluate models on the Panda-CVL test set by asking them to perform token-level correction in the same manner as human annotators. Given a user prompt, and a candidate response, the model must determine whether the response is acceptable and, if not, locate and correct its first error. The first-correction position and the human-provided replacement recorded during annotation serve as the evaluation reference.
blocks.zh: 由注释器执行的单个符号级校正可分解为三个子任务:(1)确定响应是否符合可接受的SFT数据的质量标准,在这种情况下,注释器标记为_good= Y并提交;否则,(2)在答复中指明第一个不适当的标志;(3)通过从候选标志中选择或手动编辑将其更正为适当的标志. 在此分解后,我们通过要求熊猫-CVL测试集上的模型以与人类注释者相同的方式进行符号级校正来评价模型. 考虑到用户的迅速性和候选反应,该模型必须确定反应是否可接受,如果不能接受,则确定和纠正其第一个错误。 第一次更正职位和在注释中记录的由人提供的替换作为评价参考。

blocks.en:
To support this evaluation, we design a prompt template that requires the model to produce its correction in a find-and-replace format. If the response requires no modification, the model should output <|split|><|is_good|><|split|> . Otherwise, it should output <|split|> { matched_text } <|split|> { matched_index } <|split|> { replacement_text } <|split|> .
The matched text is a short span beginning at the first inappropriate token and is used to locate the error. The match index identifies which occurrence to replace when the span appears multiple times; it is 0 in most cases. The replacement text is a short correct span that replaces the match and begins the corrected continuation.

blocks.en: We expand the response trajectories in the 652 test conversations into 2,126 evaluation instances, comprising 652 final acceptable responses labeled as good and 1,474 intermediate responses labeled as not good. Because the evaluated models use different tokenizers, we require replacement spans to cover multiple tokens. Using the Qwen3.6 tokenizer, we compute correction triples for two pairs: (1) the ground-truth negative response and the final acceptable response from the same conversation, and (2) the ground-truth negative response and the response obtained by applying the model-generated correction. A prediction is considered correct if the two resulting triples are identical. This procedure enables tokenizer-agnostic evaluation across models. The complete prompt template and evaluation implementation are provided in the accompanying onpanda repository.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented onPanda, an annotation tool centered on token-level correction. Through the locate–correct–continue loop, annotators precisely steer model generation with a few clicks and edits, efficiently producing alignment data and agent trajectories that stay close to the rollout model’s distribution, while automatically retaining every correction as fine-grained supervision. Experiments and a user study show that onPanda reduces annotation time and workload while preserving data quality. We open-source onPanda and release the Panda-CVL dataset and benchmark, hoping the community will exploit token-level correction as a novel supervision signal for more efficient post-training.
blocks.zh: 我们在熊猫上展示了一个以符号级修正为中心的注释工具。 通过定位 - 正确 - 连续环路,注释者通过几击和编辑精确地引导模型生成,高效地生成与推出模型分布相近的对齐数据和代理轨迹,同时自动保留每条修正作为精细的监管. 实验和用户研究显示,在熊猫上减少注释时间和工作量,同时保持数据质量. 我们开放Panda的源头,发布Panda-CVL数据集和基准,希望社区利用象征性的校正作为新型的监督信号,提高培训后的效率.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Participants in our efficiency experiment and user study are full-time data annotators at our institution; the tasks fall within their regular salaried duties, and participation was voluntary and informed. Survey results are reported only in aggregate, and no personally identifiable information is disclosed in this paper. The annotation tasks involve image-description content without offensive or high-risk material. The released Panda-CVL contains only images created by us or under open licenses, manually reviewed before release to exclude personally identifiable information and inappropriate content, and is intended for research use only. As a general-purpose annotation tool, onPanda yields data whose properties depend on its users’ annotation guidelines; we encourage practitioners to follow responsible data curation practices.
blocks.zh: 我们的效率实验和用户研究的参与者是本机构的全职数据注释员;任务属于他们正常的有薪职责,参与是自愿和知情的。 调查结果仅以汇总方式报告,本文件没有披露任何个人可识别的信息。 注释任务涉及图像描述内容,没有冒犯或高风险材料。 释放的熊猫-CVL只包含我们或根据公开许可证制作的图像,在释放前进行人工审查,以排除个人可识别的信息和不适当的内容,并仅供研究使用。 作为通用的注解工具,熊猫号上的数据属性取决于用户注解指南;我们鼓励从业人员遵循负责任的数据校验做法。

blocks.en: We analyze annotation agreement on Panda-MultiRef-21 1 1 1 https://github.com/on-panda/Panda-MultiRef-21 , comprising 21 image-description prompts with four independent onPanda annotations of the same initial response per prompt (84 annotations). Human pairwise location agreement is 30.95% under exact matching, far above the uniform random-location baseline of 0.20%; with a tolerance of four tokens, the rates are 44.44% and approximately 1.84%, respectively (Figure 3 ). blocks.en: Appendix C Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录C 工作

blocks.en: General-purpose platforms such as POTATO Jurgens et al. (2026) and Argilla Argilla () can be configured for post-editing or preference annotation, and POTATO 2.0 further supports online and offline agent-trajectory annotation. Closest to our work is Reptile Dou et al. (2025) : targeting terminal-based SWE tasks, it lets annotators locally edit model-output text to trigger continuation, which its terminal environment parses and executes before resuming the rollout, thereby yielding SFT data with higher on-policy fidelity than full manual post-editing. However, Reptile’s corrections rely almost entirely on text manually typed by annotators rather than selected from the model’s own candidate tokens, inevitably limiting the data’s on-policy fidelity; its current implementation also encodes reasoning and actions as plain text and shell commands, and cannot support general tool-call formats. By contrast, onPanda combines selecting from probability-scored candidate tokens with continuation over structured reasoning and tool calls, covering plain-text LLM, multimodal, and agent data, and explicitly records each correction’s position, replacement text, and pre-/post-correction samples. We do not compare against Reptile directly because it targets terminal-based SWE tasks with different environments and action representations; we compare workflows rather than benchmark the systems head-to-head on a shared task.
blocks.zh: POTATO等通用平台 Jurgens等人(2026年)和Argilla Argilla ()可以配置为编辑后或偏好注释,POTATO 2.0进一步支持在线和离线代理-导注. 与我们的工作最接近的是Reptile Dou et al. (2025): 瞄准基于终端的 SWE 任务,它让注释者在当地编辑模型输出文本以触发续作,它的终端环境在恢复推出前会进行剖析和执行,从而产生SFT数据,其政策上的忠诚度高于完整的手动编辑后. 然而,Reptile的校正几乎完全依赖于由注释者手动输入的文本,而不是从模型本身的候选符号中选择的文本,这不可避免地限制了数据在政策上的忠诚性;其目前的实施也将推理和行动编码为纯文本和shell命令,不能支持一般的工具调用格式. 相比之下,在熊猫上,从概率计分的候选符号和结构化推理和工具调用之上的续作相结合,涵盖LLM、多式联运和代理数据,并明确记录每个更正的位置、替换文本和修正前/修正后样本。 我们并不直接与Reptile进行比较,因为它针对基于终端的SWE任务,具有不同的环境和动作表现;我们比较工作流程,而不是将系统头对头设定为共同任务的基准.

blocks.en: For fine-grained supervision, PRM800K Lightman et al. (2024) collects step-level labels through human annotation, while TLDR Fu et al. (2025) constructs token-level labels from synthetic perturbations. In contrast, onPanda’s token-level correction signals are position-precise and naturally paired as positives and negatives, arising directly from the annotator’s process of constructing qualified responses, without extra human labeling or synthetic perturbation.
blocks.zh: 对于细纹监理,PRM800K Lightman等人(2024年)通过人类注释收集阶梯级标签,而TLDR Fu等人则收集阶梯级标签. (2025)从合成扰动中构造了符号级标签. 相比之下,在熊猫的标志级校正信号是位置精准的,自然配对成正数和负数,直接产生于注释者构建合格响应的过程,而不需要额外的人类标签或合成扰动.

blocks.en: The pattern of “correcting a prefix and regenerating the suffix” predates the LLM era: Predictive Translation Memory Green et al. (2014) and INMT Santy et al. (2019) already applied it to interactive machine translation. onPanda brings this mechanism into general-purpose alignment-data annotation and extends it to multimodal and structured agent scenarios, exporting branches of the annotation tree as three data types: SFT, preference, and token-level correction.
blocks.zh: “修正前缀和重新生成后缀”的模式在LLM时代之前就已经存在:预测性翻译记忆Green等人(2014年)和INMT Santy等人. (2019)已经将其应用于交互式机器翻译. 在熊猫号上将这一机制引入了通用的对齐数据注释中,并扩展到多式联运和结构化代理情景,出口注释树的分支作为三种数据类型: SFT,偏好,以及符号级的校正.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The core interaction of onPanda relies on two inference-API capabilities: continuing generation from an assistant-message prefix, and returning top- k k candidate logprobs (probability refresh further requires prompt_logprobs ). Some proprietary APIs do not expose both, so onPanda cannot annotate on-policy data for the models behind them. In practice this constraint is mild: official APIs from many vendors---including the proprietary Doubao, as well as DeepSeek, Kimi, and StepFun---already provide both prefix continuation and logprobs; for open-weight models, mainstream inference frameworks such as vLLM and SGLang natively support all required features, llama.cpp and ollama cover the core interaction, and vLLM-based hosted services such as W&B Inference 2 2 2 https://wandb.ai/inference work with onPanda out of the box. Moreover, reasoning and tool-call continuation for a new model requires adapting its response template; with our reference implementations and development guide, a coding agent can usually complete the adaptation automatically, though it remains a one-time integration cost.
blocks.zh: 熊猫上的核心交互依赖于两个推论-API能力:从一个助理消息前缀持续生成,返回顶级-kk候选日志(概率进一步刷新需要迅速_logprobs. 一些专有API并不同时披露两者,因此在Panda上无法为背后的模型对政策数据进行注释. 在实际操作中,这种限制是温和的:许多供应商的官方API——包括专有的Doubao,以及DeepSeek,Kimi,和StepFun——已经提供了前缀续写和日志;对于开放量级模型,主流推论框架,如vLLM和SGLang在本土上支持所有必需的特性,llama.cpp和ollama覆盖了核心交互,以及VLLM基于主机的服务,如W&B Inference 2 2 2 https://wandb.ai/inference 与盒外的Panda的工作. 此外,新模式的推理和工具调用需要调整其反应模板;根据我们的参考实施和开发指南,一个编码代理通常可以自动完成调整,尽管它仍然是一次性的整合成本。

blocks.en: Second, the efficiency and on-policy advantages of token-level correction rest on a sparse-error premise: the model should produce responses whose local logic is largely sound, so that human intervention is needed only at a few positions. When the model falls far short of the target task and corrections become dense, both advantages diminish; annotators can then fall back to free-form editing, which onPanda also supports. Moreover, the on-policy property is relative to the rollout model at annotation time: its benefit fades when the data is used to train a different model, or as the trained model’s weights are continually updated.
blocks.zh: 第二,象征性更正的效率和政策上的优势取决于一个稀疏的前提:模型应产生其局部逻辑基本合理的反应,因此仅在少数位置需要人为干预。 当模型远远达不到目标任务,并且修正变得密集时,两者的优点都会减少;然后注释者可以回到自由格式的编辑,这在熊猫上也是支持的. 此外,当数据被用于训练不同的模型时,或当训练有素的模型的权重不断更新时,其好处就会消失。

blocks.en: Finally, our empirical evidence has its own boundaries: the controlled experiment is modest in scale (3 annotators × \times 21 image-description prompts, a single rollout model), and the user-study participants all come from our in-house annotation team; quality evaluation primarily relies on LLM-as-a-judge, supplemented by a small human comparison between onPanda and POTATO; automated judgments may still reflect judge-specific preferences despite position-swapped comparisons. We do not conduct a controlled agent study; the agentic evidence is limited to system capability and deployment statistics. More importantly, this paper validates annotation efficiency, output quality, and the distributional properties of the produced data, whereas the downstream training benefit of token-level correction signals remains unverified by training experiments.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的经验证据有其自身的界限:受控实验规模不大(3个注释员×\时21个图像描述提示,一个单一的推出模式),用户学习参与者都来自我们内部的注释小组;质量评价主要依靠LLM-as-a-判断,辅以Panda和POTATO之间的小人比较;自动化判决仍然可能反映法官特有的偏好,尽管立场被抹去的比较. 我们不进行受控物剂研究;物剂证据仅限于系统能力和部署统计。 更重要的是,本文验证了所生成数据的注解效率、产出质量和分布特性,而符号级校正信号的下游培训惠益仍未通过培训实验得到证实。

blocks.en: Appendix D Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 今后的工作

blocks.en: Token-level correction data offers supervision that is precise in both position and direction, with naturally paired positive–negative signals. To verify its downstream training benefit, we are developing post-training methods built on such data: the token-level correcting model , a token-level counterpart of reward models, and token-level correction optimization , a token-level counterpart of DPO. The benchmark released with this paper evaluates exactly this correction capability, providing a ready testbed for the correcting model.
blocks.zh: Token级校正数据提供在位置和方向上都精确的监管,自然成对的正负信号. 为了验证其下游培训的好处,我们正在开发基于这些数据的训练后方法:象征级校正模式、奖赏模式的象征级校正模式、以及象征级校正优化,这是DPO的象征级校正模式。 本文公布的基准正是评价这种校正能力,为校正模型提供了一个现成的试验台。

blocks.en: A correcting model can in turn assist annotation by pre-locating suspicious tokens and proposing fixes for annotators to review. Moreover, onPanda can be integrated with a training pipeline into a closed loop: each newly annotated batch triggers an incremental training step and updates the served rollout model, which then assists subsequent annotation. As the model improves, corrections grow sparser and annotation keeps getting cheaper, while the data stays on-policy with respect to the latest weights—mitigating the on-policy decay noted in Limitations—so that annotation and training accelerate each other.
blocks.zh: 纠正模式反过来又能通过预先分配可疑的代币和提出供注释者审查的固定办法来帮助注释。 此外,在熊猫上可以将培训管道整合成闭环:每批新注解的批次触发一个增量培训步骤,并更新服务推出模式,然后协助后续注释. 随着模型的改进,校正越来越少,注释费用也越来越低,而数据则在最新加权数方面保持政策上,减轻限制中所指出的政策衰败,从而加速了注释和培训。

blocks.en: onPanda’s upcoming support for annotating earlier turns will yield data of a new form: guided by feedback that arrives in later turns (e.g., tool errors or user complaints), annotators revise an earlier rollout—future feedback supervising past generation. This mirrors the supervision structure of online learning from textual feedback, where deployed agents continually receive compiler errors, tool failures, and users’ textual corrections, all pointing to concrete mistakes in earlier outputs. Historical-turn annotations could therefore become a natural data source for this direction: models (e.g., the correcting model) trained to translate such feedback into token-level corrections of earlier rollouts would let LLMs learn continually from real interactions without scalar rewards. In this vision, token-level correction serves as a unified intermediate representation that turns arbitrary textual feedback—from annotators, environments, or end users—into trainable supervision.
blocks.zh: 在熊猫即将开始的对前几轮注释的支持中,将产生新的数据:以后几轮反馈(如工具错误或用户投诉)为指导, 这反映了在线从文字反馈中学习的监督结构,部署的代理人不断收到编译器错误、工具故障和用户的文字更正,所有这些都指出了早期产出中的具体错误。 因此,历史转折说明可以成为这一方向的自然数据来源:经过培训将这种反馈转化为对早先推出的象征性更正的模型(例如纠正模型)将使LLMs能够不断从真正的互动中学习,而不必获得分级奖励。 在这个愿景中,象征性的校正是一种统一的中间代表,它将任意的文字反馈——从注释者、环境或终端用户——变成可训练的监督。
